relations.subject: Ralph Lilley Turner
relations.evidence: Learned Sanskrit at Perse School in Cambridge from —> W. H. D. Rouse, who was its Headmaster.

relations.subject: Ralph Lilley Turner
relations.evidence: Studied classical and Oriental languages at Cambridge.

relations.subject: Ralph Lilley Turner
relations.evidence: In 1912 Fellow of Christ’s College (hon. fellow 1950).

relations.subject: Ralph Lilley Turner
relations.evidence: In 1913 joined Indian Educational Service and became Lecturer in Sanskrit at Queen’s College in Benares.

relations.subject: Ralph Lilley Turner
relations.evidence: In 1920-22 Professor of Indian Linguistics at Benares Hindu University.

relations.subject: Ralph Lilley Turner
relations.evidence: From 1922 the first full-time Professor of Sanskrit at S.O.A.S. (London University)... As Professor retired as emeritus in 1954

relations.subject: Ralph Lilley Turner
relations.evidence: from 1937 its Director (succeeding Ross)... continued as Director to 1957.
